title: On the Willmore energy of Möbius bands
summary: We show that among Möbius bands in $\mathbb{S}^3$ bounded by a great circle, the minimal Willmore energy is realized by an embedded minimal Möbius band with Morse index two. To prove this, we introduce a $2$-parameter ``canonical family" associated to any non-orientable surface in $\mathbb{S}^3$ with boundary a great circle and apply a min-max argument. The canonical family detects the Euler number of the surface and is inspired by the $5$-parameter family discovered by F.C. Marques and A.
